findings: `src/svg/shape/shape.c`: `attributes_supported` accepts stroke presentation attributes for the root `<svg>` and `<g>` elements, but stroke parsing only runs for basic shapes. Those attributes are silently ignored, despite inheritance being unsupported and unsupported input required to fail explicitly.

`src/raster/shape_render.c`: dashed strokes add joins only when `i + 1 < count`, so a dash that remains on across a closed outline’s final-to-first vertex gets no seam join; the two fragments are handled with caps instead. Current dash-join coverage exercises an open polyline, not a closed outline seam.
summary: The supplied deterministic checks and evidence support the acceptance criteria, and the earlier native cap/join/dash coverage gap has been corrected. These two remaining cases violate the required bounded stroke semantics, so the candidate does not pass.
